memo.summary: Context-only committee read: the US remains in a low-confidence, transitioning Q2 reflation regime with a MIXED world-state verdict. The principal tension is not a calibrated crash edge: leadership remains intact and volatility is normalizing, while breadth is weak, real yields are restrictive and rising, term premium is rising, credit stress is confirming, and liquidity is neutral-hollow. The risk radar is CAUTION, but its own measured 21-day pullback rate is 16.0% versus a 17.8% base rate, so it remains an early watch rather than an edge. Factor evidence is immature: only 10 panel dates, no Pair G ledger, no surviving scorecard factors, and no factor-attention track record. One hypothesis was registered for forward grading: intact leadership combined with sub-30% breadth and confirmed credit stress may weaken 21-day entry quality versus the intact-leadership control; evaluation date is 2026-11-02.
what_fired: Rates/credit conjunction: 10-year real yield 2.88%, rising term premium, bear-steepening curve, and confirmed credit stress.
Participation deterioration: 24.25% of constituents above the 50-day average, 43.38% above the 200-day average, breadth divergence present, while leadership remains intact.
Cross-asset disagreement: bonds and FX diverge from the equity Q2 regime; cross-asset confirmation reports 0% agreement.
Four shadow attention items were recorded: long-end premium shock; selective-concentration/credit tension; semiconductor-underweight thesis conflict; and breached Long-Treasury thesis falsifier.
A conditional-regime hypothesis was registered with a pre-committed 21-day excess-mean-difference gate and minimum 12 effective episodes.
memo.contradictions_review: Current graph contains six contradictions. The main macro tensions are Q2 reflation versus a rates-dominated CAUTION radar, and bonds/FX versus the equity regime. These do not justify escalation: the radar state is below its own historical pullback base rate, leadership remains intact, and volatility is normalizing. The Master Brain ledger also contains stale open theses whose falsifiers or directional assumptions conflict with current evidence. Long-Treasury overweight explicitly fails its stated real-yield-above-2.50% plus bear-steepener test under the current 2.88% real yield. Multiple semiconductor-underweight theses conflict with confirmed AI-infrastructure leadership, SMH 20-day momentum of +14.35%, and a 93.3rd-percentile 252-day reading. Factor Pair G is dormant because the panel has fewer than 60 dates, so there is no factor contradiction evidence to interpret.

Demand-chain: only 8 effective events at 5 days and 4 at 21 days; Q2 21-day mean is negative and the family is still accruing.

Desk families at 63 days—AI, narrative, radar, stock, thematic, and policy-intent—show negative signed excess and remain unarmed or vacuous.
Risk-radar family: large samples but pooled signed excess is slightly negative; no independent arming evidence.
Cortex attention: only one previously graded synthetic event, reliability 0.1111; A2 remains unearned.
deserves_operator: Long-end premium shock: retain attention while real yields remain above 2.50% and term premium keeps rising; clear if the real yield falls below 2.50% and bear-steepening ceases for five sessions.

Selective concentration plus credit stress: retain while fewer than 30% of constituents are above the 50-day average and confirming credit stress persists; clear after breadth exceeds 40% and stress is off for five sessions.

Open semiconductor-underweight theses conflict with current leadership evidence. Clear the conflict only if SMH underperforms SPY over the next 10 sessions and semiconductor leadership breadth falls below 50%.
Open Long-Treasury overweight thesis has met its own stated falsifier: real yield above 2.50% plus bear-steepening. Clear only if real yield reverses below 2.50% and the bear-steepener ends.
Operational evidence gap: numerous open Master Brain theses are past check-by dates but remain unscored; this weakens reliance on the brief’s current thesis ledger.
Data caveat: factor panel history is below threshold, options-flow history is immature/partial, and several source feeds failed or are stale. These are coverage limits, not confirming evidence.
